Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning access of tribal members to state land.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to access of tribal members to state lands; andadding a new section to chapter 79.10 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79.10 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The closure of any state lands, including any roads, maintained bythe department shall not restrict access by any member of a federallyrecognized tribe to any open and unclaimed lands where the tribe has atreaty right to hunt.
